name.zh: 受 Onychonycteris 启发的宽翼指爪早期蝙蝠

description.en: Original low-poly brief: block broad primitive bat wings with claws retained on all wing digits with a small number of readable masses; preserve negative spaces and joint transitions. Use a restrained neutral palette; simplify surface texture only after the silhouette reads. Validate the diagnostic feature before detailed geometry.
description.zh: 原创低多边形说明：用少量清晰体块组织所有翼指保留爪的宽早期蝙蝠翼；保留负空间与关节过渡。采用克制的中性色；轮廓成立后再简化表面纹理。精细几何制作前须核实鉴别特征。

sources.supports: Onychonycteris finneyi: Eocene, claws on all five fingers, short broad wings, relatively long hind limbs. Echolocation inference is not needed for the asset.

reconstruction_notes.en: Short broad membranes and five wing-digit claw cues per side follow basic museum-supported morphology. Soft tissue, friendly face, palette, pose, nominal size and simplified supports are artistic, not a modern species or exact fossil restoration. No echolocation or flight mechanism is asserted; static, unrigged model.
reconstruction_notes.zh: 短宽翼膜及每侧五个翼指爪提示参考博物馆支持的基础形态。软组织、友善面貌、配色、姿态、名义尺度及简化支撑为美术选择，非现代物种或精确化石复原。不主张回声定位或飞行机制；仅静态无骨骼模型。

scientific_scope.en: Independently reviewed original stylized-inspired static teaching art. Palette, pose, nominal dimensions and simplified anatomy are artistic choices; not a strict scientific reconstruction or coexistence claim.
scientific_scope.zh: 通过独立审查的原创静态风格化启发教学美术；配色、姿态、名义尺寸及简化解剖属于美术选择，不作严格科学复原或同域共存主张。
